run_split_htmls_to_pages: run the CLI to split HTML and PDF papers into per-page markdown files with optional OCR
run_process_paper: run process_paper to parse a single HTML PDF pair into split markdown pages and rasterized images
run_process_htmls: run process_htmls to batch process multiple HTML PDF pairs using a multiprocessing pool
review_process_paper: review process_paper to understand how HTML is parsed, markdown is split by page, and OCR is applied
refactor_process_htmls: refactor process_htmls to change the multiprocessing pool scheduling or timeout behavior for batch paper processing
